title: Run servers, publish sites, upload anything
items: Live dev server: it can run a Flask/Node app and you use it right in the app (serve)
One-tap publish to GitHub Pages (you approve every time)
File picker fixed: any file type, several at once (iOS greyed out non-images)
Capability check: tick which tasks to run and which to exclude
Several NVIDIA API keys rotate automatically; a rate-limited key sits out and another takes over

title: It can build bigger things, and checks its work
items: Asks you questions: tap-to-answer cards when a request is ambiguous (ask_user)
Verify gate: it can't say done after changing code until a check passed, otherwise it says "Not verified"
Repo map and symbol search to navigate big codebases
Optional self-review: a fresh reviewer checks the diff (Model sheet)
Sense of time: it now sees timestamps in your time zone on messages, answers and tool results
Can add connectors (remote MCP), save skills and schedule routines itself (you approve each)
Won't deny tools it has: a guard sends wrong "I can't" answers back, plus a `capabilities` tool and a new Capability-check task

title: Capability check grows up
items: Choose reasoning effort (Off / Medium / High) and a Hard suite of 12 real tasks
Past runs are saved so you can compare models and effort levels
New Compile C++ task

title: More languages and tools
items: Settings → Toolchain packs: scipy/pandas, cmake/clang and Emscripten, installed only when needed and cached on GitHub
Every command is memory-capped so one runaway script can't kill the server
Previews can run WebAssembly and multi-file pages
Settings → Skills: reusable instructions the agent can save for every chat (you approve them)

title: Self-management, backups and worlds
items: The agent can propose MCP connectors, routines and worlds from chat (you approve each)
Settings → Platform check and Backup & restore
Worlds can look things up on the web, and you can read and mute them
